notes.title: Patch v0.1.1
notes.notes:
🚀 Hello Dark Zone Community! 🚀

We hope you're enjoying the latest demo update! Our goal is to make Dark Zone the best experience possible, and for that, we need your help!

If you come across any bugs, big or small, or if you have suggestions to make the game even more amazing, we want to hear from you! Your feedback is crucial to us.

Head over to the #feedback channel on Discord and share your thoughts. We're keeping an eye on every suggestion to make Dark Zone something everyone will love!

Thank you for being part of this incredible community! 🎮✨

Changes Made in "Campaign - Demo" and Round Mode

✅ Improvements
[olist]
 Enhanced the weapon flashlight lighting.
[/olist]
✅ Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Addressed issues with certain map collisions.
 Fixed various bugs.
[/olist]
✅ Optimizations
[olist]
 Performance adjustments.
 Tweaked zombie animation sequences.
[/olist]
